extracted.name: Ex-Girlfriend's Mom's Salsa Fresca (Pico de Gallo)
extracted.description: This salsa fresca recipe is a fresh-tasting combination of tomatoes, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and lime to serve with chips or your favorite Mexican dishes.
ingredient_lines: 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped - or more to taste
2.5 cups Roma (plum) tomatoes, seeded and chopped
instruction_lines: Mix red onion, jalapeño pepper, and lime juice in a bowl. Allow to stand for 5 minutes. Mix in tomatoes, cilantro, and salt; allow to stand 15 more minutes for flavors to blend.
